content.title: Hera spacecraft returns to study DART impact on Dimorphos
content.caption: The European Space Agency's Hera spacecraft has arrived at the double asteroid system, where it will study the aftermath of the DART asteroid deflection experiment.

slides.heading: Hera spacecraft returns to study DART impact on Dimorphos
slides.text: The European Space Agency's Hera spacecraft has arrived at the double asteroid system, where it will study the aftermath of the DART asteroid deflection experiment.

slides.heading: DART experiment
slides.text: NASA's DART mission sent a small spacecraft on a suicide mission to show how humanity might deflect an asteroid on a collision course with Earth.

slides.heading: Hera's arrival
slides.text: Hera's arrival at the double asteroid system was delayed due to the launch pad in Florida, but it is now on track to study the aftermath of the DART asteroid deflection experiment.
